content:
Overview

Gilgit is a city in Gilgit-Baltistan with a population of 300,000. The capital of Gilgit-Baltistan, gateway to the Karakoram Highway and some of the world’s highest peaks. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5b growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. A relatively small share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree. The population skews young, with a median age of 23.0.
